svg.title: Parent and prerequisite relations in the CSV export case
svg.desc: A is the delivery parent of B, C and D. B is required for C to pass review, and C for D. The parent requires its own result submission and acceptance.

div.style: color: rgb(40, 52, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A · Deliver CSV export v0.1
manager owns / leader reviews

div.style: color: rgb(40, 52, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
B · Confirm export rules
manager / leader

div.style: color: rgb(40, 52, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
C · Implement CSV export
member / manager

div.style: color: rgb(40, 52, 75) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D · Verify and prepare delivery notes
other / manager
